examples.text_en: The town enjoyed years of peace and prosperity.
examples.text_zh: 这座小镇享受了多年和平与繁荣。

examples.text_en: Hard work brought the family great prosperity.
examples.text_zh: 辛勤劳动给这家人带来了巨大富足。

examples.text_en: The man was prostrate on the ground after the long race.
examples.text_zh: 长时间的赛跑之后，那人俯卧在地上。

examples.text_en: She found him prostrate and in great pain.
examples.text_zh: 她发现他俯伏着，痛苦万分。

examples.text_en: The protagonist faces a hard choice in the story.
examples.text_zh: 故事里的主人公面临艰难的抉择。

examples.text_en: She played the protagonist in the new play.
examples.text_zh: 她在这出新戏里扮演主角。

examples.text_en: His way is protean and hard to understand.
examples.text_zh: 他的行事方式变化不定，让人难以捉摸。

examples.text_en: The world is a protean place for many people.
examples.text_zh: 对许多人来说，世界是一个千变万化的地方。

examples.text_en: He is a protectionist and against free trade.
examples.text_zh: 他是个贸易保护主义者，反对自由贸易。

examples.text_en: The protectionist did not want the new trade deal.
examples.text_zh: 这位贸易保护主义者不想要那份新的贸易协议。

examples.text_en: She is very protective of her young son.
examples.text_zh: 她对年幼的儿子呵护有加。

examples.text_en: The workers wore protective gear all day.
examples.text_zh: 工人们整天都戴着防护装备。

examples.text_en: You need protein to build a strong body.
examples.text_zh: 你需要蛋白质来强健身体。

examples.text_en: This food has a lot of protein in it.
examples.text_zh: 这种食物里含有大量蛋白质。

examples.text_en: He did protend his hand to the other side.
examples.text_zh: 他把手伸向了另一边。

examples.text_en: We will protend the line to the far wall.
examples.text_zh: 我们要把这条线伸展到远处的墙边。

examples.text_en: The two countries sign a new trade protocol.
examples.text_zh: 这两个国家签署了一份新的贸易协议。

examples.text_en: He did not follow the protocol of the group.
examples.text_zh: 他没有遵守这个团体的礼仪。

examples.text_en: The proton is a part of every kind of matter.
examples.text_zh: 质子是各种物质的一部分。

examples.text_en: A proton has a very small size.
examples.text_zh: 质子的体积非常小。

examples.text_en: They build the first prototype of the new car.
examples.text_zh: 他们制造了这款新车的第一个原型。

examples.text_en: This prototype is a good example of their work.
examples.text_zh: 这个原型是他们工作成果的一个好例子。

examples.text_en: This is a prototypical example of the style.
examples.text_zh: 这是这种风格的一个典型例子。

examples.text_en: The design became prototypical for later models.
examples.text_zh: 这个设计成了后来款式的原型。

examples.text_en: He tried to protract the meeting for hours.
examples.text_zh: 他试图把会议拖上几个小时。

examples.text_en: Bad weather may protract the long journey.
examples.text_zh: 恶劣天气可能延长这段漫长的旅程。

examples.text_en: The long line will protrude from the wall.
examples.text_zh: 那条长线会从墙里伸出来。

examples.text_en: The big hand will protrude from the box.
examples.text_zh: 那只大手会从箱子里伸出来。

examples.text_en: The protruding line on the wall is very clear.
examples.text_zh: 墙上那条突出的线非常明显。

examples.text_en: The protruding part was a real problem for them.
examples.text_zh: 那个突出的部分对他们来说是个实实在在的麻烦。

examples.text_en: A small protuberance appeared on the tree trunk.
examples.text_zh: 树干上出现了一个小突起。

examples.text_en: He felt a strange protuberance on his head.
examples.text_zh: 他摸到头上有块奇怪的隆起。

examples.text_en: The protuberant part of the wall was clear.
examples.text_zh: 墙上突起的那个部分清晰可见。

examples.text_en: A protuberant point was on the top of the box.
examples.text_zh: 箱子顶上有一个突起的小点。

examples.text_en: The painting has a clear provenance and history.
examples.text_zh: 这幅画有清晰的来源和流传记录。

examples.text_en: Experts checked the provenance of the ancient cup.
examples.text_zh: 专家核查了这只古杯的出处。

examples.text_en: The group did not have enough provender for the day.
examples.text_zh: 这群人没有足够的食物应付这一天。

examples.text_en: They give the group provender and water.
examples.text_zh: 他们给这群人提供粮草和水。

examples.text_en: He is proverbially slow to make a decision.
examples.text_zh: 众所周知，他做决定很慢。

examples.text_en: The town is proverbially quiet in the early morning.
examples.text_zh: 众所周知，这座小镇清晨很安静。

examples.text_en: A provident man saves for hard times.
examples.text_zh: 有远见的人会为艰难时期存钱。

examples.text_en: She was provident and planned for the future.
examples.text_zh: 她很有远虑，为未来做了打算。

examples.text_en: Their meeting seemed providential and rather lucky.
examples.text_zh: 他们的相遇像是天意，相当幸运。

examples.text_en: It was a providential escape from real danger.
examples.text_zh: 那是一次幸运的脱险，躲过了真正的危险。

examples.text_en: His views showed a narrow provincialism.
examples.text_zh: 他的看法带有狭隘的乡土气。

examples.text_en: Travel can reduce the provincialism of small towns.
examples.text_zh: 旅行能减少小城镇的乡土偏见。

examples.text_en: The government has a provision for the poor.
examples.text_zh: 政府为穷人提供了一项补助。

examples.text_en: They did not have enough provision for the long week.
examples.text_zh: 他们没有足够的储备来应付这漫长的一周。

examples.text_en: This is only a provisional plan for the group.
examples.text_zh: 这只是给这个团体的一个临时计划。

examples.text_en: They have a provisional decision about the new law.
examples.text_zh: 关于这项新法律，他们有一个暂定的决定。

examples.text_en: The two countries sign a provisory deal.
examples.text_zh: 双方签署了一份有附带条件的协议。

examples.text_en: It was only a provisory offer from the company.
examples.text_zh: 那只是公司提出的一个有附带条件的报价。

examples.text_en: Her dress was bold and rather provocative.
examples.text_zh: 她的裙子很大胆，也相当惹眼。

examples.text_en: He asked a provocative question about the plan.
examples.text_zh: 他就这个计划提出了一个带刺激性的话题。

examples.text_en: Do not provoke the dog in the dark.
examples.text_zh: 不要在黑暗中去激怒那条狗。

examples.text_en: His words will provoke a strong response.
examples.text_zh: 他的话会激起强烈的回应。

examples.text_en: The provost spoke to the students at noon.
examples.text_zh: 教务长中午对学生们讲话。

examples.text_en: A new provost will lead the college soon.
examples.text_zh: 一位新教务长很快将领导这所学院。

examples.text_en: The cat likes to prowl at night.
examples.text_zh: 这只猫喜欢在夜里潜行。

examples.text_en: Wolves prowl through the forest after dark.
examples.text_zh: 狼群天黑后在森林里潜行。

examples.text_en: The proximate cause of the fire was not known.
examples.text_zh: 这场火灾的近因尚不清楚。

examples.text_en: They could not find the proximate reason.
examples.text_zh: 他们找不到最直接的原因。

examples.text_en: We chose the hotel for its proximity to work.
examples.text_zh: 我们选这家旅馆是因为它离上班地点近。

examples.text_en: The proximity of the shops is very handy.
examples.text_zh: 商店就在附近，非常方便。

examples.text_en: She will vote by proxy at the next meeting.
examples.text_zh: 她将在下次会议上委托他人代为投票。

examples.text_en: He was only a proxy for the main group.
examples.text_zh: 他只是代表主要团体的一个代理人。

examples.text_en: He acts like a prude about small matters.
examples.text_zh: 他在小事上装得一本正经。

examples.text_en: She is no prude and enjoys a good joke.
examples.text_zh: 她可不是拘谨的人，喜欢听好笑的笑话。

examples.text_en: She acted with great prudence and care.
examples.text_zh: 她行事非常审慎小心。

examples.text_en: His prudence saved the company from loss.
examples.text_zh: 他的谨慎使公司免于亏损。

examples.text_en: She was too prudish to enjoy that kind of fun.
examples.text_zh: 她过于拘谨，享受不了那种乐趣。

examples.text_en: His prudish way was hard for them to understand.
examples.text_zh: 他那种过分规矩的作风让他们难以理解。

examples.text_en: The choir sang a gentle quiet psalm.
examples.text_zh: 合唱团唱了一首柔和安静的圣诗。

examples.text_en: He read a psalm before the evening meal.
examples.text_zh: 晚饭前他读了一篇诗篇。

examples.text_en: The man used a pseudonym for his first book.
examples.text_zh: 那人给他的第一本书用了笔名。

examples.text_en: He is known by a pseudonym in the group.
examples.text_zh: 在那个团体里，他以一个假名而为人所知。

examples.text_en: The film explores the human psyche.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影探讨了人的心灵。

examples.text_en: Music can deeply affect the human psyche.
examples.text_zh: 音乐能深深影响人的精神。

examples.text_en: She studied psychoanalysis for many years.
examples.text_zh: 她研究心理分析多年。

examples.text_en: His book offers a clear psychoanalysis of fear.
examples.text_zh: 他的书对恐惧做了清晰的心理分析。

examples.text_en: She teaches psycholinguistics at the local college.
examples.text_zh: 她在当地学院教语言心理学。

examples.text_en: His main interest is psycholinguistics and language learning.
examples.text_zh: 他的主要兴趣是语言心理学和语言学习。

examples.text_en: The psychologist asked many careful questions.
examples.text_zh: 这位心理学家问了许多细致的问题。

examples.text_en: She works as a child psychologist.
examples.text_zh: 她是一名儿童心理学家。

examples.text_en: He did not talk much in his early puberty.
examples.text_zh: 他在青春期早期不太爱说话。

examples.text_en: The children change a lot during puberty.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们在青春期会发生很大变化。

examples.text_en: They publicize the event on the local radio.
examples.text_zh: 他们在当地电台宣传这场活动。

examples.text_en: The group will publicize its new plan.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体将宣传它的新计划。

examples.text_en: She began to pucker her lips.
examples.text_zh: 她开始撅起嘴唇。

examples.text_en: The sour fruit made him pucker his face.
examples.text_zh: 酸果子让他皱起了脸。

examples.text_en: He gave a puckish smile and left.
examples.text_zh: 他顽皮地一笑就走了。

examples.text_en: Her puckish humor kept the party lively.
examples.text_zh: 她顽皮的幽默让聚会气氛活跃。

examples.text_en: We visited an ancient pueblo in the desert.
examples.text_zh: 我们参观了沙漠里一座古老的印第安村落。

examples.text_en: The pueblo stood high above the dry valley.
examples.text_zh: 这座村庄高高矗立在干旱的山谷之上。

examples.text_en: His puerile jokes annoyed the entire class.
examples.text_zh: 他幼稚的玩笑让全班都很不快。

examples.text_en: The argument was silly and rather puerile.
examples.text_zh: 这场争论很傻，也相当幼稚。

examples.text_en: The ad was full of empty puffery.
examples.text_zh: 这则广告尽是空洞的吹捧。

examples.text_en: Readers saw through the puffery in the report.
examples.text_zh: 读者看穿了报告里的夸大之词。

examples.text_en: He wrote a short book about pugilism.
examples.text_zh: 他写了一本关于拳击的小书。

examples.text_en: Pugilism demands speed, strength, and steady nerves.
examples.text_zh: 拳击需要速度、力量和稳定的神经。

examples.text_en: The young pugilist trained every single day.
examples.text_zh: 这位年轻的拳击手每天都训练。

examples.text_en: A skilled pugilist rarely loses his calm.
examples.text_zh: 技艺高超的拳击手很少失去冷静。

examples.text_en: The pugnacious man argued with everyone.
examples.text_zh: 这个好斗的人跟谁都争吵。

examples.text_en: She had a pugnacious way of talking.
examples.text_zh: 她说话带着一股好斗的劲头。

examples.text_en: The king showed his puissance in battle.
examples.text_zh: 国王在战斗中展示了他的威力。

examples.text_en: Few could match the puissance of that army.
examples.text_zh: 少有军队能与那支军队的强势相比。

examples.text_en: The puissant ruler controlled many distant lands.
examples.text_zh: 这位强盛的统治者掌控着许多遥远的土地。

examples.text_en: A puissant army marched toward the small town.
examples.text_zh: 一支强大的军队向小镇进发。

examples.text_en: The poem praised the pulchritude of the rose.
examples.text_zh: 这首诗赞美了玫瑰的美丽。

examples.text_en: Her pulchritude drew the attention of many.
examples.text_zh: 她的美貌引来许多人的注目。

examples.text_en: A small pullet ran across the yard.
examples.text_zh: 一只小母鸡跑过院子。

examples.text_en: The farmer kept a pullet and two hens.
examples.text_zh: 农夫养了一只小母鸡和两只母鸡。

examples.text_en: They lifted the box with a simple pulley.
examples.text_zh: 他们用简单的滑轮把箱子吊起来。

examples.text_en: The pulley makes heavy work much easier.
examples.text_zh: 滑轮让重活轻松了许多。

examples.text_en: Fish pullulate in these warm shallow waters.
examples.text_zh: 鱼在这片温暖浅浅的水域里大量繁殖。

examples.text_en: Ideas pullulate when young minds meet.
examples.text_zh: 年轻的思想碰撞时，创意不断涌现。

examples.text_en: The speaker stood high in the wooden pulpit.
examples.text_zh: 演讲者高高站在木制讲道坛上。

examples.text_en: He climbed the pulpit to address the crowd.
examples.text_zh: 他登上讲道坛向人群讲话。

examples.text_en: The bright lights pulsate to the music.
examples.text_zh: 明亮的灯光随着音乐搏动。

examples.text_en: Her heart began to pulsate very fast.
examples.text_zh: 她的心开始剧烈跳动。

examples.text_en: He could feel a pulsation in his head.
examples.text_zh: 他能感觉到头部的一阵悸动。

examples.text_en: The pulsation of the light was hard to watch.
examples.text_zh: 那灯光的闪动让人看着难受。

examples.text_en: The machine can pulverize rocks into fine dust.
examples.text_zh: 这台机器能把岩石磨成细粉。

examples.text_en: They used a hammer to pulverize the stone.
examples.text_zh: 他们用锤子把石头砸成粉。

examples.text_en: Waves pummel the rocks along the shore.
examples.text_zh: 海浪拍打着岸边的岩石。

examples.text_en: He began to pummel the heavy bag.
examples.text_zh: 他开始猛揍那个重沙袋。

examples.text_en: She is punctilious about every small detail.
examples.text_zh: 她对每个小细节都一丝不苟。

examples.text_en: His punctilious habits annoyed the other workers.
examples.text_zh: 他拘泥细节的习惯让别的工人不快。

examples.text_en: A sharp nail made a small puncture.
examples.text_zh: 一枚尖钉扎出一个小孔。

examples.text_en: The puncture in the tire let air out.
examples.text_zh: 轮胎上的刺孔漏了气。

examples.text_en: The pundit spoke about the coming election.
examples.text_zh: 这位权威人士谈论了即将到来的选举。

examples.text_en: A well known pundit wrote the article.
examples.text_zh: 一位知名专家写了这篇文章。

examples.text_en: The pungent smell filled the small kitchen.
examples.text_zh: 刺鼻的气味充满了小厨房。

examples.text_en: A pungent sauce gave the dish flavor.
examples.text_zh: 一种辛辣的酱汁给这道菜添了味道。

examples.text_en: The puny man could not move the big box.
examples.text_zh: 那个瘦弱的人搬不动那个大箱子。

examples.text_en: It was only a puny amount of money.
examples.text_zh: 那只是微不足道的一笔钱。

examples.text_en: The purblind man did not see the car.
examples.text_zh: 那个半盲的人没有看见那辆车。

examples.text_en: He was purblind and could not find his way.
examples.text_zh: 他视力半盲，找不到路。

examples.text_en: He did it purely for the good of the group.
examples.text_zh: 他做这件事纯粹是为了团体的利益。

examples.text_en: This is purely a question of time and money.
examples.text_zh: 这纯粹是时间和金钱的问题。

examples.text_en: This water is the purest in the region.
examples.text_zh: 这水是这一带最纯净的。

examples.text_en: She spoke with the purest kind of joy.
examples.text_zh: 她带着最纯粹的喜悦说话。

examples.text_en: The doctor gave him a mild purgative.
examples.text_zh: 医生给他开了一种温和的泻药。

examples.text_en: Such herbs act as a gentle purgative.
examples.text_zh: 这类草药有温和的通便作用。

examples.text_en: The long wait felt like pure purgatory.
examples.text_zh: 漫长的等待简直像炼狱。

examples.text_en: He described the journey as a kind of purgatory.
examples.text_zh: 他把这段旅程形容成一种炼狱。

examples.text_en: The party began a purge of its members.
examples.text_zh: 该党开始清洗自己的成员。

examples.text_en: They tried to purge the system of errors.
examples.text_zh: 他们设法清除系统中的错误。

examples.text_en: The process of purification takes several days.
examples.text_zh: 纯化的过程需要好几天。

examples.text_en: Water purification keeps the village healthy.
examples.text_zh: 水质净化让村民保持健康。

examples.text_en: The purified water tastes clean and fresh.
examples.text_zh: 净化过的水喝起来干净清爽。

examples.text_en: They sold purified air in small cans.
examples.text_zh: 他们把净化过的空气装在小罐里出售。

examples.text_en: These plants purify the air in the room.
examples.text_zh: 这些植物能净化室内的空气。

examples.text_en: We use a filter to purify the water.
examples.text_zh: 我们用过滤器来净化水。

examples.text_en: The purity of the spring water surprised us.
examples.text_zh: 这泉水的纯净让我们惊讶。

examples.text_en: She spoke with a rare purity of feeling.
examples.text_zh: 她说话带着一种少见的真挚纯净。

examples.text_en: These woods were once a royal purlieu.
examples.text_zh: 这片树林曾是王室的属地。

examples.text_en: He knew every purlieu of the busy town.
examples.text_zh: 这座热闹小镇的每个角落他都熟悉。

examples.text_en: He tried to purloin a small book.
examples.text_zh: 他试图偷走一本小书。

examples.text_en: Someone managed to purloin the rare stamp.
examples.text_zh: 有人设法偷走了那枚珍稀邮票。

examples.text_en: The purport of his talk was not clear.
examples.text_zh: 他讲话的要旨并不清楚。

examples.text_en: They did not understand the purport of the new law.
examples.text_zh: 他们不理解这项新法律的目的。

examples.text_en: The purported letter was never found.
examples.text_zh: 那封据称存在的信始终没被找到。

examples.text_en: We saw the purported site of the battle.
examples.text_zh: 我们看了据说是战场的地点。

examples.text_en: She gave up the pursuit of wealth.
examples.text_zh: 她放弃了追求财富。

examples.text_en: The pursuit of knowledge takes real effort.
examples.text_zh: 追求知识需要真正的努力。

examples.text_en: Small shops purvey fresh food to the town.
examples.text_zh: 小店铺向镇上供应新鲜食物。

examples.text_en: They purvey rare books to keen readers.
examples.text_zh: 他们向热心读者供应珍本书籍。

examples.text_en: The pusillanimous man did not stand and fight.
examples.text_zh: 那个怯懦的人没有站起来反抗。

examples.text_en: His pusillanimous way was a problem for the team.
examples.text_zh: 他胆怯的作风成了团队的麻烦。

examples.text_en: The putative father was later proved wrong.
examples.text_zh: 这位推定的父亲后来被证明是错的。

examples.text_en: They named the putative cause of the fire.
examples.text_zh: 他们指出了火灾的推定起因。

examples.text_en: Left in the heat, the meat will putrefy.
examples.text_zh: 放在热处，肉会腐烂。

examples.text_en: Dead plants slowly putrefy in the wet ground.
examples.text_zh: 死去的植物在湿地里慢慢腐烂。

examples.text_en: The putrid food was a problem for the group.
examples.text_zh: 那些腐臭的食物成了这群人的麻烦。

examples.text_en: The putrid air was hard for the young child.
examples.text_zh: 那腐臭的气味让小孩受不了。

examples.text_en: His sudden silence was rather puzzling.
examples.text_zh: 他突然的沉默相当令人费解。

examples.text_en: The results of the test were quite puzzling.
examples.text_zh: 测试结果相当令人困惑。

examples.text_en: A pygmy goat stood near the gate.
examples.text_zh: 一只矮山羊站在大门附近。

examples.text_en: They studied a small pygmy tribe.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究了一个矮小的部落。

examples.text_en: A tall pylon carried the power lines.
examples.text_zh: 一座高耸的塔架支撑着电线。

examples.text_en: The plane flew past the steel pylon.
examples.text_zh: 飞机从钢塔架旁飞过。

examples.text_en: They built a pyre of dry wood.
examples.text_zh: 他们用干木柴搭起一堆火葬柴堆。

examples.text_en: A large pyre burned through the night.
examples.text_zh: 一大座柴堆烧了整夜。

examples.text_en: The doctor said he suffered from pyromania.
examples.text_zh: 医生说他有放火狂。

examples.text_en: Pyromania is a rare and serious condition.
examples.text_zh: 放火狂是一种罕见而严重的病症。

examples.text_en: The duck let out a loud quack.
examples.text_zh: 那只鸭子发出响亮的嘎嘎声。

examples.text_en: We heard a quack from the pond.
examples.text_zh: 我们听到池塘里传来一声鸭叫。

examples.text_en: The students sat in the quiet quadrangle.
examples.text_zh: 学生们坐在安静的四方庭院里。

examples.text_en: A large quadrangle forms the center of the school.
examples.text_zh: 一个宽阔的四方院构成学校的中心。

examples.text_en: A quadruped has a strong and large body.
examples.text_zh: 四足动物有一个强壮而硕大的身体。

examples.text_en: A dog is a kind of quadruped in this world.
examples.text_zh: 在这个世界上，狗是一种四足动物。

examples.text_en: He began to quaff the cold water.
examples.text_zh: 他开始大口喝下凉水。

examples.text_en: They quaff sweet juice after the long race.
examples.text_zh: 长途赛跑后他们畅饮甜果汁。

examples.text_en: The car sank into a deep muddy quagmire.
examples.text_zh: 汽车陷进了深深的泥沼。

examples.text_en: The project became a real financial quagmire.
examples.text_zh: 这个项目变成了真正的财务泥潭。

examples.text_en: A small quail ran across the field.
examples.text_zh: 一只小鹌鹑跑过田野。

examples.text_en: The quail hid among the tall brown grass.
examples.text_zh: 鹌鹑躲在高高的褐色草丛中。

examples.text_en: We stayed in a quaint little village.
examples.text_zh: 我们住在一个古雅的小村子里。

examples.text_en: The shop has a quaint quiet charm.
examples.text_zh: 这家店有一种古雅而安静的魅力。
